# Third-party license supplement

`colord/LICENSE.md` contains the MIT license for `@pixi/colord@2.9.6` (Vlad Shilov, https://github.com/omgovich/colord). The installed npm distribution declares MIT but does not include the license text. The text is preserved from the previous dependency license inventory and is included by `scripts/notices.mjs` in the built `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt`.

Simpludify is installed from npm. Its license is read from the installed package at build time. No Simpludify source is stored here.
